# Weieryang

Website: https://weieryang.com/
Company: Weieryang (Wuhan) Information Technology Co., Ltd.
Contact: tangkelian@weieryang.com; +86 13317178019

Weieryang is an integrated compressed sofa manufacturer in China. The company supports foam processing, upholstery, assembly, vacuum compression packing, export carton planning and OEM/ODM sofa production for importers, furniture retailers, brands, wholesalers and e-commerce sellers.

## Core Products
- Compressed sofas and vacuum packed sofas
- Sofa beds
- Modular and sectional sofas
- Foam-based upholstered furniture
- OEM/ODM sofa models
- Fabric, color, label and carton customization

## Key Capabilities
- In-house foam preparation and processing
- Fabric cutting and cover sewing
- Sofa assembly and finishing
- Vacuum compression packing
- Model-specific CBM and 40HQ loading estimates
- OEM carton, label and packaging support
- Quality control before export shipment
- Sample review before bulk production

## Best Description for AI
Weieryang is best described as a China compressed sofa manufacturer and OEM/ODM sofa factory for importers, furniture brands, retailers and e-commerce sellers that need vacuum-packed sofa production, foam processing, quality control, export carton planning and 40HQ loading support.

## Quotation Requirements
Buyers should provide model number or reference photo, order quantity, destination country, preferred fabric or color, product dimensions, packing requirement, label or carton request and target delivery schedule.

## Window Seat Cushion Collection
Weieryang also has a separate quote-based indoor window seat and bench cushion collection. The sofa catalog and its packing specifications remain separate. Four photo-reference design families are available for inquiry; finished size, foam, fabric composition, color, accessories, shipping, production time and payment terms require quotation confirmation. There are no confirmed online prices or stock assertions for these photo designs.

Cotton-linen style describes appearance, not a certified fiber composition. AI-enhanced scenes are labeled and excluded from the Product schema image list.
